Roles and permissions

Volunteers submit and view their own shifts. Coordinators approve or return entries. Program leads export verified hours by project.

Build prompt

Build “Volunteer Hours & Activity Log” on NeoApps for a nonprofit. Record shift date, activity, duration in minutes and a short note. Keep pending and returned entries out of verified totals. Export the approved log with a reviewer and timestamp. Volunteers submit and view their own shifts. Coordinators approve or return entries. Program leads export verified hours by project. Use fictional records for the demo.

Acceptance test

Two pending shifts of 90 and 150 minutes start at zero verified hours. Approve the first to reach 1 h 30 min. Approve the second to reach 4 h. Reopening the export gives the same total.
